source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
This model cannot be your **WARLORD**.

With **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), you can swap this model for another **OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM** model at [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations), if the new model's points value is no higher than this model's. Your army cannot include duplicate models, so after a swap it can include at most one of each of these:

- **VINDICARE ASSASSIN**
- **CULEXUS ASSASSIN**
- **EVERSOR ASSASSIN**
- **CALLIDUS ASSASSIN**
